envelope.description: Attachment chips on the user row

body.title: Attachment chips on the user row
body.summary: render-registry.ts: toViewModel, in its host and webview copies, carries attachments on a user row; the user row renders a chip per attachment under the text (kind glyph, name, size; textContent only, no image loaded); the registry gains the setter onAttachmentOpen(cb), returned on the registry object beside onApprovalDecision and onSelectionDecision; a chip click calls it with the attachment's id.
acceptanceChecks: A user row with attachments renders one chip per attachment, built with textContent only
A chip click calls the open sink with that attachment's id; with no sink set it does nothing
A user row without attachments renders exactly as today, and the host and webview copies of toViewModel agree

tests.name: render registry: a user row with attachments renders a chip per attachment with textContent only, a click calls the open sink with the attachment's id, and a row without attachments renders as today
